```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

qmd_in <- knitr::current_input()
if (!is.null(qmd_in) && nzchar(qmd_in)) {
  qmd_path <- normalizePath(qmd_in, winslash = "/")
  root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(qmd_path), ".."), winslash = "/")
} else {
  wd0  <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/")
  root <- if (basename(wd0) == "qmd") normalizePath("..", winslash = "/") else wd0
}

sc <- read.csv(file.path(root, "data", "scenarios.csv"))

sc |>
  dplyr::select(shock, domain, sector, transaction, shift, rho) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    domain = dplyr::recode(domain,
      "Final Demand"        = "Final Demand",
      "Intermediate Demand" = "Intermediate Demand"
    ),
    rho = ifelse(rho == 0.05, "0.05$^{\\dagger}$", "0.20")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    `\\#`          = shock,
    Domain         = domain,
    Sector         = sector,
    Channel        = transaction,
    Material       = shift,
    `$\\rho$`      = rho
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format    = "latex",
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    linesep   = c(rep("", 5), "\\addlinespace", rep("", 6)),
    escape    = FALSE,
    caption   = "Scenario Registry",
    label     = "tab:scenarios",
    align     = c("c","l","l","l","l","c")
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position"),
    font_size     = 10
  ) |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "0.4cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "3.2cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "2.2cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(4, width = "2.8cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(5, width = "2.2cm") |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(6, width = "0.8cm") |>
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general           = "$^{\\\\dagger}$ Construction scenarios use $\\\\rho = 0.05$ (smaller shock) due to the larger scale of the investment channel.",
    general_title     = "",
    escape            = FALSE,
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  )
```
